text:
If you were braced for the mostly cloudy day on the books, good news: Burlington's sitting clear at 75 with light southwest air, and that sunshine has a decent shot at hanging around longer than advertised. The official call still has clouds building toward a high near 79, but with humidity comfortable in the upper 50s and air quality good, it's a pleasant one to be outside regardless of what the sky does overhead. Winds stay light out of the south under 10 knots on the broad lake, waves a foot or less, so the water's calm and easy all afternoon. Tonight clears out further and turns cool, dropping to around 55 under a light northeast breeze.

No rain in the picture today or tomorrow, and Friday looks like the pick of the two, sunny with a high near 80. Enjoy the stretch: the forecasters have showers holding off until Saturday night into Sunday. Good evening for the waterfront through sunset around 7:50; grab an extra layer if you're out much past dark tonight, lows will feel more like fall than August.
